GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1.0 Lengths Settled Down third last fence 5 Lengths (1600m), leading pair got away this well back however back they came in the run To The Turn , Straightened Up still 5 Lengths away, wacked away running into a # well beaten second
Jumped okay & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn , hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # back/ran on fairly

Jumped awkwardly and missed start at least a length, Settled Down last on fence 12 Lengths from the lead, Hooked Out 3 Wide at 1000m, worked up to 3 Lengths Four Wide turning, widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground down the outside in straight. (Bandages (Hind) OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to race. Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey reported it missed the start and settled rearward.
